connect.title: Bluetooth
connect.no_devices:
No paired device found.
Pair your radio / BT module in system settings first.
connect.demo_hint: Demo mode injects simulated $PKWDWPL sentences (using real captured station data) so you can verify the UI and parser without a radio.
connect.strict_checksum_hint: When off, sentences with a wrong checksum are still parsed (marked as checksum mismatch).
connect.permission_hint: The "Nearby devices" permission is required to scan/connect.

stations.title: APRS Stations
stations.empty:
No data yet.
Connect your radio — incoming $PKWDWPL sentences will show up here.
stations.empty_filtered: No station matches the current filter.

map.title: Offline map
map.center_on_hint: Tap a station marker to center it
map.tap_hint: No network, no GPS needed. A base image is optional — without one a lat/lon grid with station positions is shown.

detail.title: Station detail
detail.distance_estimated_hint: * Computed from your reference position; otherwise field 11 of the sentence is shown.
detail.warn_field_count: Abnormal field count ({} instead of 12) — a comma was likely lost during capture/forwarding; parsed with the tolerant rule
detail.warn_callsign: Callsign does not match the amateur-radio callsign format (possible transcription error)
detail.warn_checksum: NMEA checksum mismatch — this record may be corrupted or mistyped

settings.field11_hint: On some firmwares this field is a distance, on others a speed. Pick what your radio actually reports.
settings.reference_none: Not set (field 11 of the sentence is shown)
settings.map_bounds_hint: Leave empty to derive it from the received stations.
settings.map_image_hint: Absolute path to a local image (empty = lat/lon grid)
